notes: librosa analysis of audio/track_cut.wav. Tempo drifts (median 126.23 BPM); beats from DP tracking, locally smoothed (+-6 beats). Downbeat phase from harmonic change (beat index 1 mod 4). Sections from the lyric alignment (analysis/align_lyrics.py): vocal sections start at their first sung word, instrumental boundaries on the beat grid. Envelopes: 100 fps, one-pole 10/90 ms, each /99th percentile. Stems approximated (HPSS for drums/bass, Demucs htdemucs_ft stem for vocal).
